settings.title: Keep *everything* you earn
settings.body:
Learners pay through your own **Stripe**, **Lemon Squeezy** or **Razorpay** account, so the money goes straight to you. CourseLit takes no cut of your sales on any plan.

- Free, one-time, subscription (monthly or yearly) and instalment plans of 2 to 60 payments
- Several plans per course, download or community
- Bundle courses and downloads into a community plan

[How payments work](/payments)

settings.title: Let your AI assistant set up your school
settings.body:
CourseLit has a built-in MCP server. Connect **Claude**, **ChatGPT** or **Cursor** to your school, describe what you teach, and the assistant drafts your course, pricing and pages for you.

It acts with your permissions, creates everything as a draft and asks before it publishes anything.

[Build with the API and MCP](/developers)

settings.title: Open source, so you're never locked in
settings.body:
CourseLit's code is public on GitHub under the AGPL-3.0 licence. Self-hosted CourseLit includes every feature, with no licence key and no paid edition.

items.question: Does CourseLit take a cut of my sales?
items.answer: No. Learners pay through your own Stripe, Lemon Squeezy or Razorpay account, and CourseLit charges no transaction fee on any plan. Your payment provider's own fees still apply.

items.question: What happens after the free trial?
items.answer: Your trial lasts 14 days and needs no card. To keep your school, choose Pro or Business. If you don't, your school becomes read-only for 15 days and is then deleted.

items.question: Can I send emails during the trial?
items.answer: Your learners still get sign-in codes, receipts and access emails. Marketing emails, such as broadcasts and sequences, start once you're on a paid plan.

items.question: Can I use my own domain?
items.answer: Yes. Add a domain such as learn.example.com in your website settings and create the two DNS records CourseLit shows you.

items.question: Is self-hosting really free?
items.answer: Yes. The code is open source under AGPL-3.0 and self-hosted CourseLit has every feature. You run and pay for your own servers, database, storage and email service.
